title: Never Fold
description: Wellness night with Coach Verla, founder of Vertical, a posture craze with one rule: a person who sits down has folded, and folding is a small death. Devotees rent a Leaning Post and retire their knees, and the whole standing-only cult slowly closes in on Barry, the last man still willing to sit.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM, and tonight, we stand tall. With us is Coach Verla, founder of a wellness movement called Vertical. Verla, welcome.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Standing. Okay. I already do that one. While I wait for the bus.

lines.speaker: verla
lines.text: Thank you, stander. <p:0.3> You think you stand. But every night, you lower yourself into a chair. And in that moment, stander <p:0.3> you fold.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Folding. Now that's a real journey, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: What's wrong with sitting? Sitting is, you know. Resting.

lines.speaker: verla
lines.text: Resting is folding, stander. <p:0.3> A person who sits has chosen a small death. The true practitioner never lowers himself again.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Okay but where do you SLEEP?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Let's not rush her process, Barry. Coach, tell us about the Leaning Post.

lines.speaker: verla
lines.text: For a small monthly devotion, the stander rents a Leaning Post. <p:0.3> You rest against it, upright, forever. And once you are ready, we retire the knees.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Retire the... you take the knees? That's, that's the joints, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Hi Ronnie. I rented the Leaning Post in MARCH and I had my knees RETIRED in April. <p:0.3> I have never felt TALLER.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You don't bend your knees at all anymore?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I FOLDED once, Barry. <p:0.3> In an elevator. There was a little bench. I am still ASHAMED. But Coach Verla forgave me, and now I stand at the dinner table, and I stand in the shower, and I STAND.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now THAT is a woman with spine, Barry.

lines.speaker: verla
lines.text: Patricia, show them. <p:0.4> Lock the hips.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Is that the standing thing? My boy joined the standing thing. <p:0.3> He hasn't folded since March. He won't come to dinner anymore, he just leans in the doorway because he can't bend down to the chair.

lines.speaker: verla
lines.text: Your son is advancing beautifully, stander.

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: He's leaning a funny color, Verla. I made his favorite. <p:0.3> He just leans there, swaying.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: He's just on a higher tier of the practice, ma'am. He'll lean at the retreat.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Yeah, hi, Chad here. <p:0.3> Forget the posture. Verla, who's the upline? Are Leaning Post territories still open in the north?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The UPLINE? It's a standing cult, Chad, there's no... there's no territory.

lines.speaker: verla
lines.text: It's a practice, stander. <p:0.3> Bring nine recruits, Chad, and you keep the dues for your whole zip code.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Nine recruits. <p:0.3> And what's the resale on an already-unfolded recruit? Like, a guy whose knees are already retired, what's my cut?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: You can't RESELL a person, Chad! Okay, I have been standing this whole segment, and my back is, my back is genuinely starting to...

lines.speaker: verla
lines.text: Do not lower yourself, stander. <p:0.3> Hold the line.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Don't fold, Barry!

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: Don't fold, sweetheart!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Stay unfolded, you're worth more!

lines.speaker: verla
lines.text: Never fold.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Taller!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Oh, that's the chair. <p:0.3> Ohhh, that is so much better.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: He FOLDED!

lines.speaker: caller-mildred
lines.text: He folded!

lines.speaker: verla
lines.text: He has lowered himself. <p:0.3> A small death, on the air.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I don't care, Ronnie, I'm sitting, I have wanted to sit for forty minutes and I am, I am sitting.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And it's a beautiful surrender, Barry. <p:0.3> So beautiful, in fact, that I already signed you up for Vertical and rented you a Leaning Post. <p:0.3> Fellas, take the chair.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Wait. <p:0.3> Why is it rolling. Why is my chair, Ronnie, that's my, where are they taking the...

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's retired, Barry. <p:0.3> We'll see you and the whole studio at Coach Verla's free Vertical Retreat this weekend. I just booked it. <p:0.4> Stand easy, folks. <p:0.3> You don't have a choice anymore.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: ...There's nowhere to sit down.
